Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses sulfo-SDA for high-density cross-linking (HD-CLMS). While not a standard PTM modifier in the provided list like phospho or ubiquitin, it falls under complexome/structural proteomics. The acquisition is clearly DDA (Top 8 most intense signals).

scope: A total of nine proteins were received from five labs.
YaaA (PDB|5CAJ) was received from the lab of Prof. Mark Wilson (Department of Biochemistry/Redox Biology, University of Nebraska), as a frozen solution
Five proteins, 413472 (GS13694A), BACUNI_01052 (PDB|4QE0), RUMGNA_02398 (PDB|4QAN), SAV1486 (PDB|4QPV) and BACCAC_02064 (PDB|4QHW), were received from the lab of Dr. Ashley M. Deacon
MmR495A (no structure in PDB) was received from the lab of Prof. Gaetano Montelione
Af1502 (PDB|5A1Q) was received from the lab of Dr. Jörg Martin
Laminin (PDB|4YEQ) was received from the lab of Prof. Deborah Fass
Protein monomer bands were excised from the gel, cut into pieces and then washed to remove Coomassie staining.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consisted of specific purified target proteins received as solutions or lyophilisates, which were then cross-linked and separated by SDS-PAGE before in-gel digestion for MS analysis.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a technical validation study (blind test) of a cross-linking mass spectrometry (CLMS) method rather than a differential proteomics experiment comparing biological conditions. The 'treatments' (sulfo-SDA ratios and UV times) are optimization parameters for the assay, not biological perturbations. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.

Reanalysis requires a cross-link search engine (like Xi) rather than standard peptide search engines. The analysis is site-centric (residue pairs) for the purpose of distance restraints in protein structure prediction.
